notes.title: 1.11 - MINOR UPDATE
notes.content:
1.11 - MINOR UPDATE

- Game renamed to 'Eldabyss' over 'Eldabyss 2'
- Cell Shot temporarily vaulted, replaced by Bulletstream
- Player can now quick swap weapons by pressing Q
- Minor graphical reworks
- Praxidice redesign
- Subtitle, cutscene, and interaction text now has a translucent black bar behind it for readability
- Camera parallax system reworked
- Minor level redesigns

- Extrez boss fight renamed to "1001 "The Crash"
- The Crash no longer can teleport out of his arena and softlock the player
- Discord and Youtube link buttons upscaled, and no longer have broken rotation

notes.title: 1.1 - RELEASED
notes.content:
ELDABYSS 2, update 1.1 has finally came out to the public. Here's everything to expect!

UPDATE 1.1 - THE DISC 2 UPDATE

- GREED added; new bosses, new demons, all that jazz - just continue from your saved vessel as usual
- Boss arenas slightly altered
- Level select added
- Menu screen altered
- Discord button added
- Limbo slightly altered
- Lust slightly altered
- Gluttony slightly altered
- BM-001 slightly altered
- The Mind In Stasis slightly altered
- The Artistry of Hardware slightly altered
- Flesh Tesseract slightly nerfed
- ESSENCE OF THE NIGHT added - transform into a bat!
- New performance-friendly blood system
- Settings accessible in pause menu
- Auto-saving
- Railbeam causes screenshake
- Settings accessible from the pause menu
- Healing has an effect
- Dashjumping removed due to being redundant as a feature
- REQBLADE remaster - actual slashing
- HOME GATE remaster - renamed to EXTERMINATION DIVISION, decorated
- New statues for Lust
- Shot-crucifix, Nailed Rocket, Cell Shot, and Railbeam have all been reworked in some degree
- Icarian Greaves added - double jumping!
- Player damage output increased slightly
- New Demon doors; kill an enemy assigned for death to open them
- New explosion effects
- Maikki's chapel cutscene re-written
- Flesh Tesseract theme has been changed
- Difficulty descriptions added

PATCHES / FIXES

- Blood bugs fixed
- Difficulty buttons no longer have a chance of being partially off-screen
- Blood sprays significantly increased
- Minor graphical updates
- Beginning cutscene slowed down to ideal speed
- Some animation reworking
- Parrying game-freeze fix

Enjoy!

~ Fleshed Out Interactive LLC

notes.title: BREAKING THE SILENCE ONCE MORE
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852667/034b20b709dd354c8403f0eb882d6b50e8b84421.png

Hey y'all!

Just another post where we break the silence; 1.1 is still in work, and the first half will release soon!
Greed's already got a lot waiting for you; be ready!

- Tons of new enemies! The Armored Bulb, the Cult Swordsman, the Cult Rocketeer, the N.A.E.L., and so much more!
- New FOREST X polishes; background upgrades, rain graphic upgrades, cutscene upgrades, the whole nine yards...
- Enemy reworks! The Behemoths are much more aggressive and faster now, and the Hellhounds jump at you and roll around now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852667/1eaeb6d64bdd2c6cb3d045186d5ee719f516fe45.png

- A run-in with your rival Esca and his cult turns into an all-out wave based attack!
- Atop the Clock Tower, the goddess Dali awaits your arrival, ready to bring you down...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852667/226c75f7de91f920e72604cbb6b98a389d43547c.png

- New weapons are in work! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852667/68e77cf6b3739eaae7571dd241f0326e848ade58.gif

- Also, tons of weapon reworks; The Nailed Rockets ramp up in damage as they fly, the Shot-Crucifix fires more powerful bullets, the Cell Shot fires TWO bullets now, and the Reqblade and Railbeam have been entirely reimagined!
- Even more! [strike]We might need to call an exterminator...[/strike]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852667/09eba6f7501c6cda0c1b9815837faf93511ee362.png

- And last but certainly not least - the whole DISC 1 SOUNDTRACK is up on Youtube for you to listen to! Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=4YmUEIGdsE8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

We'll see you again very soon. Thank you for supporting ELDABYSS 2!

notes.title: 1.1 IS IN WORK
notes.content:
Hey yall!

It's been radio silent for a bit, but I finally have something to show you guys; here's part of what's coming in the next update, 1.1!

Some noteworthy features that you might catch:
- GREED is in work! A Clock Tower sits among an endless sea of blood, disguising itself as a mansion, but really being a twisting monolith run by the Goddess Dali.
- Ebic can turn into a BAT now! An upcoming ability called Essence of the Night will allow you to transform into a bat!
- New blood system! A lot more performance friendly, and easy to heal off of!
- Two new enemies! An Armored Bulb, a much beefier version of the standard bulb, and the Cult Swordsman, a cultist following Esca, made to guard Hell.
- REQBLADE rework! It functions like an actual sword now! Are you ready to have epic duels with your foes?!
- Plenty of bug fixes and QOL features added!
- AND MORE!!!!!

Enjoy! It's all coming to you soon!

[previewyoutube=xG9iHrteDTw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
